confirmedSourceLoss.finding: Upper serif of the initial V in Vivace is above the candidate owner crop. This is actual source ink, not a guard padding failure.
confirmedSourceLoss.pixelAreaCaveat: Counts use dark pixel centers; row554 is wholly above the cut, row555 intersects the fractional cut. Do not report all56 pixel cells as wholly removed.

independentPublishedReference.note: Published exact-correction source is a separate low-resolution raster reference; inspected to check effect on existing output coordinate space.

unreviewedScope: 77additional smaller-contraction bands plus expanding-only changes are not independently source-certified here. Root held the setting after the major-edge/new-overlap findings. All140 assignment identities were compared automatically.
frozenGuardCaveat: 56 checks include overlaps/duplicates from separate existing guard families.53pass in both; p35 ViolinI broad guard and p22Cello lower guard plus one nested landmark remain existing failures on untouched pages. No guard value was modified.
sharedDirectionCaveat: Candidate inventory sourceMarkings are empty for p2s1 ViolinI. A separately merged full Vivace source copy could retain the word elsewhere but does not make this standalone crop source-complete; no such merged output was inspected.

wholeNeighborMetric.caveat: Net7to6 hides two newly retained complete neighboring staves. Both p28s2 violin source contexts independently inspected.

coordinateNotes: Each source image was mapped with its own physical pageWidth/pageHeight, not a constant615pt height. Page2 is427x614pt and1800x2589px. Some corrected source pages are426pt wide. All candidate/baseline physical dimensions and saved normalized corrections match; no raw-only guard was reused for a corrected page.
